segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle Opening
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the cold open with a high-tempo freestyle rap over a Democratic trap beat, thanking subscribers and derailing into surreal culinary and bodily-fluid musings before being banished back to hell.

segments.title: DNC Protests, Trump-Netanyahu Call, Mike Lindell Disguise
segments.notes: Blackwell covers Chicago DNC protests with 55+ arrests, conflicting reports on Trump allegedly calling Netanyahu to delay a ceasefire (Logan Act implications), and Mike Lindell shaving his mustache as a failed DNC disguise to harass a 12-year-old.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Sign-Off
segments.notes: Ripple closes the news pool with his signature lukewarm pool metaphor and departs for the super jet.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein Street Interviews: Gorilla Bike, Mustache Sentience, Pre-Recorded Confession
segments.notes: Trip interviews a gorilla claiming to be a bike who loves Mike Lindell, a sentient mustache abandoned by Lindell, a fifth-dimensional foodie, and a pre-recorded 'night man' who admits to time-traveling submissions; Trip's alerts fail due to StreamRobot misconfiguration.

segments.title: Bill Clinton DNC Speech Live Reaction
segments.notes: Blackwell and chat watch Bill Clinton's DNC address live; Clinton endorses Harris, references Epstein plane, jokes about his age (78), and signs off with 'God bless America.'

segments.title: Munch & Crum: The Great Coat Election
segments.notes: Munch and Crum debate five viewer-submitted blazer options (shiny blue, Joker red, gold sequin, gold solid, classy pink); Crum rigs the poll to guarantee a top-two finish, but chat votes gold into a landslide victory.

segments.title: Amongst the Web: Kiss Cam Tragedy, Mall Logic, Booker T Horniness, Finger Cleaner, AI Reed Hoffman, Drunk Hulk Hogan
segments.notes: Blackwell and AI Rooney rate viral clips: a kiss-cam mishap, gender double-standard mall interview, Booker T's NXT schtick, an automatic finger cleaner, AI-generated Reid Hoffman digital twin, and a drunk Hulk Hogan ranting about Kamala Harris.

segments.title: AI Rooney Rant: Hogan, AI Nuance, Trip Pre-Records, Democrat Wrestler, Piss Drinkers, Garage Gorilla
segments.notes: AI Rooney delivers a multi-topic rant generated from chat complaints, covering Hulk Hogan's racism, AI's failure to grasp 'gay,' Trip's pre-recorded interviews, Democrats lacking a wrestler, childhood heroes turning racist, Ben never using AI Rooney, urine therapy, and a hulking garage ape.

segments.title: Closing & Raid to NoMePro
segments.notes: Blackwell confirms gold coat order, teases Patreon stream with CastHim tomorrow, and raids NoMePro.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors the broadcast, manages Hype Train derailment, covers DNC protests and Lindell stunt, reacts to Bill Clinton live, oversees coat poll rigging, hosts Amongst the Web and AI Rooney.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Opens the show with a freestyle rap over a Democratic trap beat, thanks subscribers, spirals into surreal piss/culinary riffs before being dismissed.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivers the news pool segment on DNC protests and Trump-Netanyahu call, signs off with the super jet bit.

characters.name: Trip Bradstein
characters.notes: field correspondent. Conducts street interviews from Central Park bushes; interviews a gorilla-bike, sentient mustache, fifth-dimensional foodie, and a time-traveling pre-recorded 'night man'; alert system fails due to StreamRobot.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Debates Crum over five blazer options, accuses Crum of coat theft, loses the poll to gold sequin coat, rants about Olympics and Goodwill Games.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Rigs the coat poll to secure a top-two finish, claims snail-goo resilience, describes ancestral badminton with horses and bone-reading, gets threatened with police by Munch.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Appears briefly at close; Blackwell asks if he can smell the difference between robot and human food.

characters.name: AI Rooney
characters.notes: cyborg commentator. Co-hosts Amongst the Web, malfunctions on 'gay' detection, delivers a multi-topic rant from chat complaints covering Hogan, AI nuance, Trip's pre-records, Democrat wrestler deficit, piss drinkers, and garage gorilla.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Mentioned off-screen: Case must help her at 6:37 PM per chat reminder; 'Night Kendall' appears in Trip's park realm.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News covers DNC protests and a Trump-Netanyahu Logan Act allegation, then pivots to Mike Lindell's failed mustache disguise at the convention. Trip Bradstein's street interviews descend into surreal encounters with a gorilla-bike, a sentient mustache, and a time-traveling pre-recorded caller exposing Trip's alert failures. The broadcast watches Bill Clinton's live DNC speech, then Munch and Crum rig a viewer poll to select a gold sequin blazer for the network. Amongst the Web rates viral clips including a drunk Hulk Hogan rant, before AI Rooney delivers a sprawling rant on Hogan, AI language failures, Trip's pre-records, and a garage-dwelling animatronic ape.
